name: Sailor Fuku to Femme Fatale
original_name: セーラー服とファムファタル
source:
...That's right. I am your femme fatale.
I am your femme fatale, your absolute destiny, the woman who will lead you to your doom.
This is me. This is your fate.
I will lead you to a gentle and tender doom.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30983]Freem![/url]]
translation:
…这是正确的。我是你的蛇蝎美人。
我是你的蛇蝎美人，你的绝对命运，将带领你走向灭亡的女人。
这就是我。这就是你的命运。
我将带领你走向温柔而温柔的厄运。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30983]Freem![/url]]
